claim.statement: The publisher's current Checkpoints guide states that checkpoints are enabled by default and that after file edits, commands and other tool uses Cline snapshots project files in a separate shadow Git repository for comparison or restoration.

source.title: Cline Checkpoints guide
source.locator: How It Works; Enable or Disable Checkpoints; Restoring Checkpoints

limitations: This is a rolling publisher capability claim captured on 31 July 2026, not independently tested recovery behavior.
File snapshots cannot by themselves establish reversal of command side effects, network actions, credential changes or external writes.
unknowns: Checkpoint failure modes, storage limits and restoration completeness were not tested.
Whether checkpoint behavior differs between the Legacy and Next 4.1.2 variants is unknown.
